scope.task: Choose which entities this policy watches and save only that policy.

result.device_policies: Converted at setup to entity coverage with names, identities, enabled states, notifications and exclusions preserved. Broad and metadata device scopes resolve to existing device identities; future members remain covered without adding standalone entities.
result.selection: One searchable list grouped by integration and device; per-entity and filtered group checkboxes, disabled and missing choices, scoped Save/Discard. Existing dynamic entity scopes remain intact through explicit overrides.
result.device_role: Registry organization, related entity readings and issue grouping; no inferred device verdict or policy.
result.compatibility: Only generic published schema-two entity detector aliases remain; device-member scope/identity retention is removed.

retired: Device observation and per-device state-event handling
Device policy creation/restoration, ignored-member controls and device-policy picker paths
Obsolete device reducer, status, scope-identity and pilot tests

frontend_baseline.scope: Before the separately authorized Entities not provided feature wiring.

migration_and_published_entity_continuit.includes: Broad-device conversion excludes standalone and newly discovered devices; selected devices, empty scopes, missing sources, disabled policies, exclusions, notifications, reload, area overrides and invalid input remain covered.

real_ha.scope: Disposable HA, mocked destinations; exact policy selection/save/reopen, discard, keyboard, validation and complete independent settings comparison.

rendered.native_keyboard: pass: the path requires native Space on an enabled checkbox and retained focus; missing keyboard evidence cannot satisfy the inventory row.
rendered.purpose_review: The policy editor owns selection; search, group selection and missing-choice removal support that task. No disclosure or secondary picker is retained. Page scrolling, touch targets and wrapping fit both layouts.
rendered.screenshot_control: Uses the entity-list Show action; retired show-device/show-household paths are absent from policy acceptance scripts.
earlier_runner_attempts: The first native keyboard attempt selected a deliberately disabled checkbox; selectors now require an enabled input.
A native focus assertion lacked the standard assert import; the runner import was corrected.
The post-fixture screenshot action still targeted the retired device control; it now opens the entity list. Final desktop and phone runs have no diagnostics.

design_detector.review: Existing warning accent borders in unrelated views; no entity-list finding.

combined_python.scope: Final coordinated 16-module run including migration boundary, legacy entity continuity, availability isolation, unified monitoring, native configuration, named notifications, in-place methods and the separately authorized new policy.

additional_boundaries.scope: Coordinated notification/routes/disabled/defaults/dashboard regression run; overlaps other suites and is not summed.

verification.strict_production_types: pass, verified by the coordinated completion owner

coordination.production_handoff: The user-authorized Trace not monitored history chat completed combined production checks for ADRs 0103 and 0104. This chat completed the retired-device runner cleanup and final desktop/phone policy acceptance.
